newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Telefonica overhauls its board.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Telefonica overhauls its board.

text.p: Telefonica's sharp reduction in the size and members of its board is designed to prepare the company for the coming privatisation, a spokesman at the company said on Friday.
"This is another step to make the company more competitive and prepare it for the next privatisation," he said.

On Wednesday night, Juan Villalonga, chairman of Telefonica since last June, approved a reduction in the number of management committee members to 12 from 16. Of these only five were also members in the previous board of the company.

The general overhaul sets up a group corporate center, which consists of five managers already appointed and the director of finance who is expected to join the company next January. Under this committee there are five revenue center divisions.
Since Villalonga was appointed last summer, six out of the 11 board members have been nominated.
